name: What is a bathroom refresh versus a full renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is a bathroom refresh versus a full renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom refresh focuses on updating the look and feel without changing the layout or major plumbing and electrical systems. This can include new paint, fixtures, vanity, lighting, and tile. A full renovation involves significant structural changes, reconfiguring the layout, moving plumbing lines, and often replacing bathtubs or showers entirely. A refresh is typically less invasive, quicker, and more budget-friendly than a complete overhaul.
acceptedAnswer.description: A refresh updates aesthetics without layout changes; a full renovation involves structural and layout modifications.
